part.label: Pulley With Revolved Profile
part.description: A pulley resting on a base plate, with an axle hole through it -- the `revolved_profile` component kind sweeps an arbitrary cross-section (authored in the (radius, z) half-plane, not the XY plane extruded_profile uses) around the Z axis, the classic 'sketch and revolve' CAD operation for rotationally-symmetric mechanical parts none of the other component kinds can approximate directly.

components.description: Pulley body: a V-groove profile (rim at radius 10, root at radius 5) revolved a full 360 degrees around Z. Points are authored with z starting at 0 for readability; the generator would shift them to start at 0 regardless.

features.description: Axle through-hole, centered on the pulley.
